I am from Halifax, Nova Scotia. I have a Bachelor of Science in Marine Biology and a Master's in Resource Management. 
I have a keen interest in marine and ocean sciences, and I am an advocate for evidence-based environmental conservation. 
Prior to MDS I researched seagrass ecology on the Atlantic Coast of NS and worked in marine plant management on both 
the Pacific and Atlantic Coasts of Canada. I am currently completing the Master's of Data Science (MDS) program at the 
University of British Columbia. In the MDS program I am building my knowledge and applied skills in programming 
and modelling to utilize data to answer community-driven research questions in the fields of marine and environmental 
sciences.
